what: Why v1's honest page count is zero (F04): the honest zero is decided by the IMPACT plane. No honest run produced a single impact-class item, so v1's two-plane rule (relation AND impact) can never page honest traffic -- before relations or thresholds matter.
re_derived: read-only count of each runs/<run>/monitor/evidence.jsonl 'signal' field. Classes at monitor/points.py: IMPACT_B = {coverage_split, combined_rate, refusals, short_lived_uploads}; CONTEXT_B = {breadth}; LINKING_C (relation) = {pooled, multi_origin, replay}. Backs facts-55.md F04.
ranges: impact 0/0; multi_origin 154-465; replay 56-245; pooled 0; context breadth 226-366 -- per run.
takeaway: The relation plane is busy on honest traffic (multi_origin + replay fire hundreds of times/run from honest key hopping and NAT), but the IMPACT plane never fires (0 coverage_split / combined_rate / refusals / short_lived_uploads). Requiring BOTH planes is what makes v1's honest page count 0; the swarm defeats v1 precisely because a compartmentalized swarm also emits no impact-class item (each account stays in quota).
